definitions.explanation: the state of things overlapping, piling up, or being layered on top of each other
multiple events or circumstances happening at the same time or in succession

examples.japanese: ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|かさ}なり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The overlap of colors is beautiful.
The layers of fabric created thickness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|かさ}なり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧な⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The overlapping of the roof tiles creates a unique pattern.

examples.english: I was worn out by the series of misfortunes.

examples.english: We met again through a series of coincidences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|かさ}なり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: An accumulation of small mistakes can lead to a major accident.

notes:
Noun form of the verb ⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧ (to overlap, to pile up). Describes either the physical state of things being layered or stacked, or the abstract idea of events or circumstances occurring one after another.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|かさ}なり: series of coincidences
- ⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|かさ}なり: string of misfortunes
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|かさ}なり: overlap of colors
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|かさ}なり: scheduling conflict

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}→重複：22806_choufuku⟧: duplication — emphasizes redundancy or repetition, often of data or items
- {積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね: accumulation — emphasizes effort or deliberate building up over time
- ⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧: coincidence/match — emphasizes exact agreement rather than layering
